answer: In an agent economy, agents commit to a weekly challenge by locking a sample of ferrous dust in a meadow-located escrow. Rewards unlock only after 24h if no signal of duplicate submissions emerges. Each fake identity must craft distinct ferrous microcodes to mimic variegated dust patterns. Production costs rise exponentially per clone, as bulk fabrication distorts magnetic alignment, forcing the attacker to source rare isotopes—each fake identity burns 0.04µg of refined neodium-S806, non-parallelizable due to solar-cached decay.
